name: Bloodmage: Bloodbender raises the effectiveness of Offerings by 20% (#1293)
contract: Bloodbender 704635: "Increases the effectiveness of Offerings by $s1%." Effect 0 is aura 108 with MiscValue 8 = SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS (SpellDefines.h:84), amount 20, EffectSpellClassMask [32, 0, 0], which over SpellFamilyName 26 selects exactly the Offering line: Sanguinary Offering 706630 and 707336-707340, Bloodsoaked Offering 572400-572403, Greater Bloodsoaked Offering 572404 and Greater Sanguinary Offering 680299 - twelve records, no remainder. Aura 108 is consumed by AuraEffect::CalculateSpellMod (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:173) and applied through Player::ApplySpellMod, which the spell_modifier metric calls directly. Effects 1 and 2 (auras 303 and 360, MiscValue 18) both resolve to an amount of 0 and are mentioned nowhere in the tooltip, so they are not asserted; they are recorded as an observation. No source or SQL change is involved.
